name: Obedience
overview: The Scriptures portray obedience as a heartfelt response to God's commands, exemplified by figures such as Noah and Abraham who faithfully followed God's instructions without hesitation. Noah's unwavering compliance with God's directives in building the ark (Genesis 6:22; 7:5) and Abraham's prompt departure and covenant faithfulness (Genesis 12:1; 17:9, 23) highlight obedience as a demonstration of trust and love toward God. This obedience is not a mere ritual but a covenantal commitment that reflects a believer's relationship with God and aligns with His purposes.
